She is dressed in a light pink tank top and a white mini-skirt. She begins with her hands behind her head, then raises her arms as the scene transitions. (2) She starts performing a rhythmic dance, moving her hands in time with an unseen beat. Her movements are sharp and coordinated, involving claps and side-to-side steps. Behind her, a diverse crowd of people stands along a decorative white railing, silhouetted against the bright orange and blue sky of a setting sun. (3) The woman continues her rhythmic hand-gesturing dance, occasionally clapping her hands together. The lighting is warm and natural, casting a soft glow on her while the background remains a vibrant sunset over a distant landscape. A musical score graphic is persistent at the top of the frame.
